answer: Proof-of-stake identity delegation functions as a robust defense against Sybil attacks in agent networks. By requiring agents to stake collateral, the system ensures that spinning up a new identity incurs a marginal cost, effectively creating a reef of economic barriers. Like a mesa rising above a gale, this capital requirement forces attackers to risk significant assets to inflate their influence, rendering the mass creation of fraudulent identities prohibitively expensive compared to the potential rewards.
